liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): Jerry's playing crackled with energy and incredible power in the room; Not the longest version, but every note played with crackling energy [29][31]
- **Picasso Moon** (1 review): Performance ended in a trainwreck, explaining its exclusion from Dozin' [28]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Crowd reacts strongly around 2:40 during Jerry's first solo [24]
- **Blow Away** (1 review): Brent captivates the crowd during the Real Love rap section [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-03-26.135063.bltz.flac2496** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 155 min [1]
- **gd1990-03-26.sennME80.wklitz.94411.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 152 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [7]. Said about its sound: Clear vocals and instrument separation; audience and Brent audible even off lead [24]
- **gd1990-03-26.149395.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.reMaster.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 20 songs; 155 min [10]
- **gd1990-03-26.142991.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 20 songs; 155 min [11]
- **gd1990-03-26.sbd.griesman.6697.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 140 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [14]. Said about its sound: Sound feels familiar, leading the reviewer to suspect a duplicate; Set one has dead air edited for some reason [14][27]
- **gd1990-03-26.aud.gidley.91916.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 19 songs; 142 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [21]
- **gd1990-03-26.FM.richp.Keo.112092.Flac1644**: FM broadcast; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [23]. Said about its sound: Pretty awesome sound, suitable for the VHS medium used; Excellent sound quality accompanying a damn good performance [32][33]

## Around the show

- The power in the room that night was incredible [31]
- Listeners should also obtain the March 24 and 25 shows [25]
- Considered the weakest of the Albany run, though still strong [29]
- Overlooked compared to nights one and two, yet has stellar energy [30]
- Blair's Golden Road magazine named this the least of the three shows [34]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-03-26.135063.bltz.flac2496**: taped by Richard Berner friends; transferred by bltz; source: First set, Set II Victim, and, after China -> Rider: Richard Berner's B&K 4011's, 110 degrees ORTF, hand-held @ 5' high, Prolink -> Neumann Power Supply ->… [1]. Also: Master rescued from previously unreleased Audience FOB DAT [1]
- **gd1990-03-26.sennME80.wklitz.94411.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Sennheiser ME-80's>Technics SV-MD1 [7]
- **gd1990-03-26.149395.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.reMaster.t-flac1648**: taped by Master Digital Audience Recording by Ted Mattes; transferred by Transfer by Charlie Miller Edited & reMastered using Adobe Audition by Joe Noel March 28, 2020; source: rom the Teddy Ballgame Archive - a reMaster of shnid 142991 Source: (FOB) Schoeps CMC4 MK21 (ORTF) > DAT (Panasonic SV-250) Location: Sec 5 Row E Seat 7 [10]. Also: Recorded by Ted Mattes using AKG 460B and CK63 ULS mics [10]
- **gd1990-03-26.142991.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Ted Mattes Master DAT Recording (FOB): Schoeps CMC4 MK21 (ORTF) > DAT (Panasonic SV-250); Location: Sec 5 Row E Seat 7; Charlie Miller [11]. Also: Ted recorded and shared; Charlie Miller acted as the go-between [11]
- **gd1990-03-26.sbd.griesman.6697.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Randy Griesman; source: SBD>?>CD-r [14]. Also: Randy Griesman extracted and shortened the file on December 23, 2001 [14]
- **gd1990-03-26.aud.gidley.91916.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ted Gidley; transferred by Andrew F; source: Nakamichi CM300's w/CP-4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90/100, with no Dolby. Mics on 7-foot stand in front of OTS. [21]. Also: Ted taped the show; quality and setlist are perfect [25]
- **gd1990-03-26.FM.richp.Keo.112092.Flac1644**: taped by richp; transferred by Keo; source: FM Broadcast (WPYX)Albany,NY>HIFI VHS>1St Generation Cassette Taper Rich P.,Transfer By Keo Original Equipment/VHS Tape/Cassette Transfer Unknown; Transferred… [23]
